name: x402 Atlas

overview.text: x402 Atlas offers API discovery and payment analytics, with Base marked supported and Polygon, Arbitrum, Optimism and Solana coming soon despite broader multi-chain marketing. Its analytics panel shows ecosystem transactions, USDC value, buyers and providers, not customers of this analytics product or independently verified organic commerce. Promotional coverage and verification claims are not established by those displays. Free-account copy appears alongside a $49 Trial for 14 days, explicitly without a subscription, and custom-priced Premium; full-platform access is not established as free. This is x402atlas.com, distinct from 402atlas.com.
